stem cell niche marker identifies a cell as a self-renewing progenitor
resolution phase reunites M1 and M2 signals into homeostatic macrophage pool
scar collagen crosslink permanently records the healing event
granulation tissue holds both proliferative and inflammatory signals simultaneously
